lessons: The ticket's `## Regression` section says `carries: vscode-chupa/media/graph.js`, which is an implementation file. The check gate only accepts carried test or fixture files, so every attempt fails at check, however good the code is.

Fixing this needs a ticket edit: add a test or fixture file holding the reproducer to `## Scope fence`, and make `carries` name only that file. The ticket allows no file beyond view.js and graph.js, so the implementer cannot add one.

The carried reproducer must check its own prerequisites and report the result in the gate's regression protocol: pass at head, defect at the overlaid base. Neither the ticket nor merged code states that protocol's output format, so read it before writing the reproducer.

Keep the implementation. The diff (graph.js +18, view.js +9/-4) passed node --check, the lane-count check and 3029 pytest tests. A later attempt should reuse that approach and only add the carried test file.
